default.children: This is a block of content.

variant.description: Visual variant. Omit for standard bordered block; 'callout' for top-border background style.

indent.description: Left indent level applied to the block wrapper.

dedent.description: Pull the block left beyond the content edge.

big.description: Increases border width for stronger emphasis.

quote.description: Adds a quote icon and flex-row layout (non-callout only).

color.description: Border color token name. Applied as usx-border-{color} on content (or block wrapper for callout).

contentClassName.description: Additional classes for the inner content element.

attribution.description: Attribution component props object rendered by the block component.

media.description: HTML for the left media area.

primary.description: Primary text shown in the top-right cell.

secondary.description: Secondary text shown in the bottom-right cell.

children.description: Optional full custom markup, overrides media/primary/secondary.

className.description: Additional classes for the block wrapper.
